insight: Dodge is gearing up for a future dominated by electric vehicles with the upcoming launch of its electric Charger Daytona SRT in 2024.
The Dodge Challenger SRT Demon 170 marks the end of an era, being the last V8-powered car before Dodge transitions to an all-electric lineup.
Dodge aims to set a new performance benchmark with its electric vehicles, potentially rivaling the speed and power of the Demon 170.
Dodge plans to transition its loyal customer base to electric muscle cars, challenging them to adapt to the new era of high-performance EVs.
